titleEn: Vancouver Renovation Cost in 2026: Real Prices From 100+ Completed Projects
titleZh: 2026年温哥华装修费用：100+真实项目报价
contentEn:
If you are planning a renovation in Metro Vancouver, the first question on your mind is probably: "How much will this cost?" The honest answer depends on project type, scope, material choices, and your neighbourhood. Unlike most renovation websites that give you vague national averages, we share real prices from our own completed projects across Metro Vancouver.

This guide covers every major project type — kitchen, bathroom, basement, whole-house, cabinet refinishing, and commercial — with cost ranges backed by actual 聚星裝修 project data from 2024–2026.

Kitchen Renovation Cost Vancouver 2026

Kitchen renovations are the most popular home improvement project in Metro Vancouver. Prices vary significantly by scope:

  • Basic refresh (new countertops, cabinet door refacing, hardware, paint): $14,000–$20,000
  • Mid-range (full cabinetry, quartz countertops, tile backsplash, lighting): $25,000–$35,000
  • Premium custom (waterfall island, premium appliances, custom cabinetry): $35,000–$72,000

Real examples from our portfolio:

  • Coquitlam condo kitchen with budget-friendly cabinetry: $25,000–$27,000
  • Langley townhouse with white shaker cabinets and quartz: $20,000–$23,000
  • Langley kitchen with waterfall island design: $28,000–$30,000
  • Burnaby home with custom wood-vein cabinets and gold fixtures: $35,000–$40,000
  • Vancouver full custom with all premium finishes: $70,000–$72,000

Timeline: 3–6 weeks depending on scope and material lead times.

Read our detailed Kitchen Renovation Cost Guide →

Bathroom Renovation Cost Vancouver 2026

Bathroom renovation costs in Vancouver vary widely by size, fixtures, and whether you are doing a basic update or a full renovation:

  • Basic update (new vanity, fixtures, paint, minor tile work): $12,000–$18,000
  • Standard renovation (full tile, new shower, vanity, glass enclosure): $18,000–$28,000
  • Premium renovation (radiant floor, curbless shower, custom vanity, high-end tile): $28,000–$45,000
  • Luxury/multi-bath (spa-level, multiple bathrooms): $40,000–$60,000+

Real examples from our portfolio:

  • Vancouver master ensuite custom feature: $14,000–$16,000
  • Coquitlam standard bath with shower conversion: $14,000–$17,000
  • Maple Ridge custom glass door bath: $18,000–$21,000
  • Richmond dual-bath renovation: $25,000–$28,000
  • Delta 3.5-bath renovation: $40,000–$43,000
  • West Vancouver one-to-two bath conversion: $57,000–$60,000

Timeline: Single bathroom: 2–4 weeks; multi-bathroom projects: 4–8 weeks.

Read our detailed Bathroom Renovation Cost Guide →

Basement Renovation Cost Vancouver 2026

Basement renovations — especially suite conversions — are one of the best real estate investments in Metro Vancouver:

  • Basic renovation (family room, bathroom, storage, no kitchen): $30,000–$45,000
  • Full suite (one-bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, separate entrance): $40,000–$65,000
  • Premium suite (two-bedroom, full kitchen, laundry, high-end finishes): $60,000–$85,000

Return on investment: A legal basement suite in Metro Vancouver can generate $1,400–$2,200/month in rental income — renovation pays back in 2–4 years.

Read our Basement Renovation Cost Guide →

Whole-House Renovation Cost Vancouver 2026

Whole-house renovations in Vancouver vary enormously by size, age of home, and scope:

  • Cosmetic whole-house (paint, flooring, fixtures, kitchen and bathroom refresh): $50,000–$120,000
  • Moderate whole-house (selective demolition, two bathrooms, kitchen, flooring throughout): $120,000–$200,000
  • Full structural gut (complete interior strip, rewire, replumb, new kitchen, two bathrooms, drywall, flooring): $200,000–$350,000+
  • Heritage home restoration (heritage designation, structural work, period-appropriate finishes): $350,000–$600,000+

Read our Whole-House Renovation Cost Guide →

Cabinet Refinishing Cost Vancouver 2026

For Vancouver homeowners who want a kitchen refresh without a full renovation, refinishing is the highest-ROI option:

  • Cabinet refinishing (kitchen): $4,000–$9,000
  • Cabinet refinishing + new hardware: $5,500–$12,000
  • Cabinet refinishing + new countertops: $9,000–$18,000
  • Bathroom vanity refinishing: $1,500–$3,500

Read our Cabinet Refinishing Cost Guide →

Commercial Renovation Cost Vancouver 2026

Commercial renovation in Vancouver varies by use type:

  • Retail store refresh: $50–$150/sqft
  • Restaurant/kitchen renovation: $150–$350/sqft (health department requirements add significant cost)
  • Office tenant improvement: $60–$150/sqft
  • Medical/clinic renovation: $100–$250/sqft (additional regulatory requirements)

What Affects Vancouver Renovation Cost?

Age of Home

Vancouver homes built before 1990 often contain outdated electrical (fuse panels, no grounded outlets), plumbing (galvanized steel or early Poly-B piping), and may need asbestos remediation if built before 1990. Budget an extra $5,000–$25,000 for remediation in older Vancouver homes.

Strata vs. Freehold

Strata (condo/townhouse) renovations in Vancouver require strata council approval for any work affecting common property or building systems. This adds 4–8 weeks to timeline and requires contractor insurance naming the strata as additionally insured. See our cabinet refinishing and bathroom renovation services for strata-compatible project options.

Location Premiums

Vancouver neighbourhoods have distinct cost realities:

  • Vancouver West Side (Kitsilano, Point Grey, Kerrisdale): Highest labour costs in Metro Vancouver; premium material expectations; older homes requiring remediation. Budget 15–25% above Metro Vancouver average.
  • Vancouver East Side (Mount Pleasant, Hastings-Sunrise, Commercial Drive): Generally average Metro Vancouver pricing; many character homes requiring heritage consideration. Budget 5–10% above average.
  • Downtown Vancouver (Yaletown, Gastown, Coal Harbour): Condos dominate; strata approval is complex in high-rise buildings; premium for trades with high-rise experience. Budget 10–20% above average.
  • North Vancouver/West Vancouver: Difficult access (hillside properties); premium neighbourhoods; often larger homes requiring more scope. Budget 10–25% above average.
  • Richmond: Largest Vietnamese and Chinese-Canadian population; strong contractor market; competitive pricing for quality trades. Generally average Metro Vancouver pricing.
  • Burnaby/New Westminster/Coquitlam: More affordable than Vancouver proper; good contractor selection; newer construction means less remediation. Budget 5–15% below average.
  • Surrey/Langley/Delta: Most affordable Metro Vancouver market for renovation; high demand for quality contractors; shorter wait times than Vancouver. Budget 10–20% below average.

Vancouver Renovation Permits 2026

City of Vancouver Building Permit costs:

  • Building permit (residential): Based on construction value; $1,000–$5,000 for typical renovation values
  • Electrical permit: $200–$500
  • Plumbing permit: $200–$500
  • Structural permit: $500–$2,000 additional for structural work
  • Fast-track permit (City of Vancouver): 2–3 week processing for additional fee

BC requires a building permit for any renovation involving structural changes, electrical work, plumbing, or changes to building envelope. For Vancouver specifically, Poly-B pipe replacement is strongly recommended for homes built 1985–1995 before starting a renovation.

Electrical panel upgrades are required for homes with fuse panels before most renovation work.

Financing Your Vancouver Renovation

Metro Vancouver homeowners use several strategies to finance renovations:

  • Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC): Most popular; typically 4.5–7% interest; interest-only during renovation phase
  • Refinance: Replace existing mortgage with a larger one; best when rates are favourable or you need large amounts
  • Unsecured personal loan: For smaller renovations ($15,000–$75,000); faster approval but higher rates
  • BC Equity Loan: Provincial program for energy-efficient upgrades
  • Credit card: Only for small cosmetic work; avoid for large projects due to interest rates

本指南涵盖每种主要项目类型——厨房、浴室、地下室、全屋、橱柜翻新和商业——均有来自2024–2026年100多个真实项目数据的支持。

  • 基本翻新（新台面、橱柜门翻新、五金件、油漆）：$14,000–$20,000
  • 中档装修（全套橱柜、石英台面、瓷砖挡水板、照明）：$25,000–$35,000

  • 基本更新（新浴室柜、五金件、油漆、轻度瓷砖工程）：$12,000–$18,000
  • 标准装修（全瓷砖、新淋浴、浴室柜、玻璃隔断）：$18,000–$28,000
  • 高端装修（地暖、无门槛淋浴、定制浴室柜、高端瓷砖）：$28,000–$45,000
  • 豪华/多浴室（水疗级装修、多间浴室）：$40,000–$60,000+

2026年温哥华地下室装修费用

地下室装修——尤其是套房转换——是大温哥华地区最好的房地产投资之一：

  • 基本装修（活动室、浴室、储藏室、无厨房）：$30,000–$45,000

  • 高端套房（两居室、完整厨房、洗衣房、高端装修）：$60,000–$85,000

2026年温哥华全屋装修费用

温哥华全屋装修费用因房屋面积、房龄和工程范围差异极大：

  • Cosmetic whole-house（油漆、地板、设备、厨房和浴室翻新）：$50,000–$120,000
  • Moderate whole-house（选择性拆除、两间浴室、厨房、全屋地板）：$120,000–$200,000
  • Full structural gut（室内全拆、重新布线、重新管道、新厨房、两间浴室、石膏板、地板）：$200,000–$350,000+
  • Heritage home restoration（遗产指定、结构工程、时期适当饰面）：$350,000–$600,000+

2026年温哥华橱柜翻新费用

对于想要在不进行全屋装修的情况下刷新厨房的温哥华业主，翻新是最高投资回报的选择：

  • 橱柜翻新（厨房）：$4,000–$9,000
  • 橱柜翻新+新硬件：$5,500–$12,000
  • 橱柜翻新+新台面：$9,000–$18,000
  • 浴室柜翻新：$1,500–$3,500

影响温哥华装修费用的因素

房屋年龄

1990年前建造的温哥华房屋通常包含过时电气（熔丝面板、无接地插座）、管道（镀锌钢管或早期Poly-B管道），如果建于1990年前可能需要石棉 remediation。 在较旧的温哥华房屋中额外预算$5,000–$25,000。

共管vs独立产权

温哥华的共管（公寓/联排别墅）装修需要 strata 理事会批准任何影响公共财产或建筑系统的工程。这增加了4–8周的工期，并要求承包商的保险将 strata 指定为额外被保险人。

位置溢价

  • 温哥华西侧（Kitsilano、Point Grey、Kerrisdale）：大温哥华地区最高的劳动力成本；高端材料期望；可能需要 remediation 的老房子。预算比大温哥华平均水平高15–25%。
  • 温哥华东侧（Mount Pleasant、Hastings-Sunrise、Commercial Drive）：通常为大温哥华平均价格；许多特色住宅需要考虑遗产保护。预算比平均水平高5–10%。
  • 温哥华市中心（Yaletown、Gastown、Coal Harbour）：公寓为主；高层建筑的 strata 批准复杂；具有高层经验的行业溢价。预算比平均水平高10–20%。
  • 北温哥华/西温哥华：通道困难（山坡房产）；高端社区；通常需要更大范围的更大房屋。预算比平均水平高10–25%。
  • 列治文：大温哥华地区最大的越南华侨社区；强大的承包商市场；优质行业有竞争力。 通常为大温哥华平均价格。
  • 本拿比/新西敏/高贵林：比温哥华本身更实惠；良好的承包商选择；较新的建筑意味着更少的 remediation。预算比平均水平低5–15%。
  • 素里/兰里/三角洲：大温哥华地区最实惠的装修市场；对优质承包商需求高；比温哥华等待时间短。预算比平均水平低10–20%。

温哥华装修许可证2026

温哥华市建筑许可证费用：

  • 建筑许可证（住宅）：根据建设价值；典型装修价值 $1,000–$5,000
  • 电气许可证：$200–$500
  • 管道许可证：$200–$500
  • 结构许可证：结构工程额外 $500–$2,000
  • 快速许可证（温哥华市）：额外费用2–3周处理
